statusDescription: We’re discussing requirements with potential customers. Features, availability and suitability will depend on what we learn; a generally available platform is not being offered.
boundaryDescription: Your requirements will help us prioritise the problems to address and decide how to take the initiative forward. We welcome a conversation about your needs before proposing any next steps.

products.name: StylePulse
products.summary: Fashion trend intelligence to support better-informed demand decisions.
products.description: An initiative exploring how fashion brands and retailers could bring emerging trend signals into planning and merchandising conversations.
products.problem: Trend signals are scattered across channels, while merchandising teams need context they can assess alongside sales, inventory and market knowledge.

directions.title: Bring signals together
directions.description: Explore ways to organise relevant trend sources and make their provenance clear.

directions.title: Add business context
directions.description: Consider how emerging themes relate to a retailer’s categories, markets and planning decisions.

directions.title: Support human judgement
directions.description: Help teams compare signals and discuss uncertainty rather than treat a prediction as a guarantee.

products.interestDescription: Exploring better ways to identify emerging fashion trends? Share your interest and let’s discuss your requirements.

products.name: IQPublish
products.summary: A simpler approach to enterprise content operations and distribution.
products.description: An initiative exploring how organisations could structure, manage and distribute content with clearer ownership and fewer manual handoffs.
products.problem: Content often moves through disconnected tools and repeated approval steps. Teams need a clearer view of ownership, versions and destinations.

directions.title: Structure content clearly
directions.description: Explore useful content models, relationships and ownership across an organisation.

directions.title: Connect editorial workflows
directions.description: Consider review, versioning and approval needs alongside the systems teams already use.

directions.title: Plan distribution deliberately
directions.description: Explore integrations and publishing destinations based on actual requirements and constraints.

products.interestDescription: Looking to simplify enterprise content operations and distribution? Tell us about your requirements.
